facts.value: Nurses can work and/or specialise in medical or surgical nursing, care of the older person, renal nursing, oncology, theatre, palliative care, cardiac, orthopaedics, respiratory, emergency nursing or critical care.
Other career options include midwifery, children's nursing, public health nursing, education or management.
Registered General Nurses may progress their careers through advanced nursing studies, thus enabling them to assume roles, as clinical nurse specialists and advanced nurse practitioners.
Recent graduates of this programme are working as Registered General Nurses in hospitals, in the community, and in the private sector in Ireland, The EU and outside the EU.
